# 💬 Feedback Widget SaaS

A lightweight, embeddable feedback widget for any website — built with **Next.js**, **Prisma**, **PostgreSQL (Supabase)**, **ShadCN**, **Tailwind CSS**, and **Redis**.

Website owners can install a small `<script>` tag on their site and instantly start collecting feedback from users in real-time. Feedback is stored in a secure dashboard where owners can view, manage, and reply.

A full mini-SaaS product designed to demonstrate authentication, high-performance APIs, embeddable scripts, and real-world multi-tenant systems.

---

## 🚀 Features

### ✔ Authentication & Security
- Secure email/password signup & login (NextAuth.js)
- JWT-based session management
- Protected dashboard routes

### ✔ 🛡️ Rate Limiting (New!)
- **Powered by Upstash & Redis**
- Prevents spam and abuse by limiting feedback submissions per IP
- Ensures API stability and reliability under load

### ✔ Site Management
- Users can create and manage multiple "Sites"
- Each site gets a unique `siteId`
- Auto-generated embed snippet for installation
- Dashboard overview of all connected websites

### ✔ Feedback System
- Users on external sites can submit feedback using the widget
- Captures message, email (optional), page URL, and user agent
- Owners receive feedback instantly in the dashboard
- Full conversation threads: reply to user feedback
- Feedback status workflow: `Open` → `Responded` → `Closed`

### ✔ Embeddable Widget (`widget.js`)
- Tiny, zero-dependency script
- Injects a floating feedback bubble
- **Shadow DOM** styling (prevents CSS conflicts with host site)
- Clean modal UI for message submission
- Cross-platform compatibility (React, HTML, Shopify, WordPress, etc.)

---

## 🔮 Future Roadmap

We are actively working on making the widget more engaging and powerful. Coming soon:

- [ ] **AI Sentiment Analysis**: Automatically tag feedback as Positive, Neutral, or Negative.
- [ ] **Email Notifications**: Alert site owners immediately when new feedback arrives.
- [ ] **Customizable Themes**: Allow owners to match the widget colors to their brand.
- [ ] **Screenshot Attachment**: Allow users to attach screenshots of bugs directly in the widget.
- [ ] **Public Roadmap**: Option to showcase popular feedback requests publicly.

---

## 🏗 Tech Stack

| Component | Technology |
|----------|------------|
| **Frontend** | Next.js 14 (App Router) |
| **Styling** | ShadCN UI + Tailwind CSS |
| **Database** | PostgreSQL (NeonDB) |
| **ORM** | Prisma |
| **Rate Limiting** | Upstash Redis |
| **Auth** | NextAuth.js |
| **Deployment** | Vercel |
| **Widget** | Vanilla JS + Shadow DOM |

---

## 📦 Installation & Setup

Follow these steps to run the project locally:

### 1. Clone the repository
```bash
git clone [https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/feedback-widget.git](https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/feedback-widget.git)
cd feedback-widget
```

## 2. Install dependencies
```bash
npm install
```

## 3. Configure Environment Variables
```bash
# Database (Neon)
DATABASE_URL="postgresql://..."

# Auth (NextAuth)
NEXTAUTH_SECRET="your-super-secret-key"
NEXTAUTH_URL="http://localhost:3000"

# Rate Limiting (Upstash)
UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_URL="https://..."
UPSTASH_REDIS_REST_TOKEN="your-token"
```

## 4. Push Database Schema
```bash
npx prisma db push
```

## 5. Run the Development Server
```bash
npm run dev
```

## 🔌 How to Use the Widget

Once your project is deployed, users can add the widget to their site by adding this script tag to their <head> or <body>:
```bash
<script 
  src="[https://your-domain.com/widget.js](https://your-domain.com/widget.js)" 
  data-site-id="their-unique-site-id">
</script>
```
